action_items.text: Work on questionnaires and summaries regarding the current project status.

Work on individual tasks: Manuel to work on components (chips, power); Corinne to work on user interface concept (minimal buttons); Manuel/Group to explore the two-piece remote concept (quick zap device + rounded hand-fit device).
Corinne to look at the actual appearance of the remote design in the next break.
Group to work on watching trends to gather new information for the next meeting.

decisions.text: The remote will be designed specifically for television, not as a universal remote for all devices.
The remote will incorporate the corporate slogan 'we put the fashion in electronics' and the corporate colors grey, yellow, and possibly black.
Speech recognition will be removed from the design as it is deemed not worth the investment at this time.
The remote design should focus on a modern, simple look with a minimal number of buttons.
The remote should include a locator function (e.g., a holder/holster that beeps to find the remote).
The remote should be rechargeable (using rechargeable batteries or solar) and the holder could serve as the charging unit.
The remote design should be one-handed and ergonomic, potentially featuring a scrolling wheel/button for navigation.
The remote design should be optimized for right-handed users.
The group will explore a two-piece remote concept: a larger base unit and a smaller 'quick zap' device that fits into the hand.
